## Summary

What changes, and why? Link a related issue when available.

## Implemented scope

Separate delivered behavior from follow-up ideas.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Disclose failures. Include redacted browser evidence for UI changes; never include credentials or private account records.

## Research impact

Does this affect priors, observations, outcomes, metrics, determinism, or persistence? Document those changes and any compatibility effects.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and documentation is current
- [ ] Concrete tests added for changed rules where appropriate
- [ ] Checks and browser evidence described accurately
- [ ] No fabricated results or exaggerated capability claims
- [ ] Ownership, account lifecycle, and persistence considered
- [ ] No secrets or private exports included
- [ ] Contributions can be distributed under the repository's MIT license
